name: Miles Maniaci
bio:
Miles Maniaci is a highly skilled tattoo artist, specializing in realism and illustrative styles, with a reputation for transforming skin into stunning works of art. With over two decades of experience tattooing in Chicago, Miles has honed his craft at Fudo Tattoo, where clients seek him out for his impeccable attention to detail and precision in every design. To book an appointment with this in-demand artist, reach out to him at milesmaniaci@gmail.com for a professional and personalized tattooing experience.
